name: cancel_request
description: Withdraw a pending request you created — a credential request from request_external_resource, a custom-domain setup request from publish_app, or an open screenshot job from screenshot_preview (jobId from that tool). Only pending requests can be cancelled — completed ones are final — and cancelling is final too: a cancelled request can't be resumed (the user would need a new one). Use when the user says to stop or they don't want to proceed.
